speaker: amari_ndlovu
headline: SOLIDARITY NEEDS A BRIDGE, NOT A SLOGAN.
deck: Regional commitments matter only when institutions can carry a person, a record and a remedy across the administrative gap.
quote: A border can organise jurisdiction without turning a neighbour into an administrative stranger.
facts: Local institutions often hold only part of a person's story.
Records and eligibility can break when systems do not recognise one another.
Cross-border cooperation needs clear handoffs and accountable ownership.
Solidarity becomes credible when the final person receives continuity rather than repetition.
takeaway: Regional solidarity becomes real when institutions can carry recognition across the border.
